configFile.description:
Override the configuration file used by MySQL. By default,
NixOS generates one automatically from {option}`services.mysql.settings`.

dataDir.description:
The data directory for MySQL.

::: {.note}
If left as the default value of `/var/lib/mysql` this directory will automatically be created before the MySQL
server starts, otherwise you are responsible for ensuring the directory exists with appropriate ownership and permissions.
:::

ensureDatabases.description:
Ensures that the specified databases exist.
This option will never delete existing databases, especially not when the value of this
option is changed. This means that databases created once through this option or
otherwise have to be removed manually.

ensureUsers.description:
Ensures that the specified users exist and have at least the ensured permissions.
The MySQL users will be identified using Unix socket authentication. This authenticates the Unix user with the
same name only, and that without the need for a password.
This option will never delete existing users or remove permissions, especially not when the value of this
option is changed. This means that users created and permissions assigned once through this option or
otherwise have to be removed manually.

galeraCluster.clusterAddress.description: Full Galera cluster connection string. If nodeAddresses is set, this will be auto-generated, but you can override it with a custom value. Format is typically 'gcomm://node1,node2,node3' with optional parameters.

galeraCluster.clusterPassword.description: Optional password for securing cluster communications. If provided, it will be used in the clusterAddress for authentication between nodes.

galeraCluster.enable.description: Whether to enable MariaDB Galera Cluster.

galeraCluster.localAddress.description: IP address or hostname of this node that will be used for cluster communication. Must be reachable by all other nodes.

galeraCluster.localName.description: The unique name that identifies this particular node within the cluster. Each node must have a different name.

galeraCluster.name.description: The logical name of the Galera cluster. All nodes in the same cluster must use the same name.

galeraCluster.nodeAddresses.description: IP addresses or hostnames of all nodes in the cluster, including this node. This is used to construct the default clusterAddress connection string.

galeraCluster.sstMethod.description: Method for the initial state transfer (wsrep_sst_method) when a node joins the cluster. Be aware that rsync needs SSH keys to be generated and authorized on all nodes!

group.description:
Group account under which MySQL runs.

::: {.note}
If left as the default value this group will automatically be created
on system activation, otherwise you are responsible for
ensuring the user exists before the MySQL service starts.
:::

initialDatabases.description:
List of database names and their initial schemas that should be used to create databases on the first startup
of MySQL. The schema attribute is optional: If not specified, an empty database is created.

initialScript.description: A file containing SQL statements to be executed on the first startup. Can be used for granting certain permissions on the database.

replication.masterHost.description: Hostname of the MySQL master server.

replication.masterPassword.description: Password of the MySQL replication user.

replication.masterPort.description: Port number on which the MySQL master server runs.

replication.masterUser.description: Username of the MySQL replication user.

replication.role.description: Role of the MySQL server instance.

replication.serverId.description: Id of the MySQL server instance. This number must be unique for each instance.

replication.slaveHost.description: Hostname of the MySQL slave server.

secureSuperUserByDefault.description:
Whether to automatically secure the root@localhost user with auth_socket authentication.

::: {.note}
When enabled (default), the module will ensure root@localhost uses socket authentication,
preventing any local user from connecting as root without proper credentials.
:::

user.description:
User account under which MySQL runs.

::: {.note}
If left as the default value this user will automatically be created
on system activation, otherwise you are responsible for
ensuring the user exists before the MySQL service starts.
:::
